text:
alex: Quick heads-up — starting an embedding + rerank load test today. Goal: measure tail latency and batching tradeoffs for dims 768/1536/3072, payloads up to 1.2KB, and compare synthetic vs replay harness results. Will run kernel-selection profiling and KV-cache warm/unwarm runs. 

maria: 👍 Are we using synthetic Poisson arrivals or replaying prod traces? Also: what's the apples-to-apples config? 

alex: We'll do both. Plan:
- replay harness: 24h of anonymized query traces from prod replayed at 1x and 5x traffic
- synthetic: parametric arrivals (Poisson + Pareto bursts) to stress tails
- apples-to-apples: same model commit hash, quantization profile, and container image. Pin GPU type (A100-40GB) and set batcher to disabled for the isolated kernel runs. 

sam: Quick profiler dump: noticed kernel chooser picks cuBLAS GEMM for 1536 dims which regresses compared to our fused matmul for dim=1536 on recent kernel patch.
sam: Perf summary (warm KV cache): mean=12.3ms, p95=34ms, p99=78ms for batch=1, dim=1536. After kernel change p99 jumped to 142ms. 

jia: Interesting. Did we account for KV cache cold starts? Rerank often happens after generation with large contexts — KV cache behavior matters. 

alex: Yes — each scenario has two runs: KV-warmed (preload top 32 contexts) and KV-cold (no prewarm). Also measure incremental warm where only 50% keys cached. 

maria: For batching heuristics, are we using dynamic batching window? We saw earlier that 5ms window saved 20% tokens/sec but increased p99.

jia: My proposal: dynamic-window with size=5ms but early-cutoff when queue depth>max_batch/2, and an explicit tail-safety route that limits window to 1ms for tail-sensitive endpoints (rerank). 

sam: Agreed. Also run with two batcher configs in the suite: static max_batch=64 with 2ms window, dynamic window=5ms with adaptive cutoff. 

perf-bot: Test run 1 complete: replay x1, dim=768, payloads avg 450B, batching=none. Results: mean=6.1ms, p95=18ms, p99=46ms. Logs -> https://perf.redwood/reports/1719001234/run1 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex: Sharing the replay harness command for reproducibility:
``
./replay_harness --trace traces/2024-05-10-anon.json --rate 1.0 --workers 32 --target-endpoint /v1/embeddings/rerank --headers 'Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}'
```

maria: Nice. For synthetic burst tests please include Pareto alpha=1.2 so tails show up. Also vary vector dims sequentially in same job to minimize drift. 

sam: Added a flamegraph link from kernel profiler for dim=1536 where custom kernel lost to cuBLAS: https://perf.redwood/fg/1719001234/fg1

jia: Action items:
- sam: rerun kernel-selection benchmarks with kernel patch revert and report p99 (ETA 3d)
- alex: run replay x5 + synthetic bursts for dims 768/1536/3072 (ETA 48h)
- maria: bake two batcher configs into the CI perf suite and add KV caching scenarios (ETA 2d)
- perf-bot: schedule nightly regression detection job comparing p99 and 99.9 across commits

sam: noted, will also capture GPU utilization and PCIe traffic for correlation. 

alex: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the 48h run. Please paste short CSVs of p50/p95/p99 into the thread so we can graph. :rotating_light:
